# Test data

`odcs-json-schema-v3.2.0.json` is the official JSON Schema of the Open Data
Contract Standard (ODCS) v3.2.0.

- Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bitol-io/open-data-contract-standard/v3.2.0/schema/odcs-json-schema-v3.2.0.json
- Tag: v3.2.0
- License: Apache-2.0

The file is vendored unchanged. Do not edit it. The conformance test in
`odcs_conformance_test.go` validates each generated contract against it.
